'''Zephee''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Ewok]] who lived on the [[moon]] [[Endor]] and gave birth to her second daughter during the construction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. She feared what the completion of the [[superweapon]] would mean for her children. In [[4 ABY]], she was present in [[Bright Tree Village]] when her [[Bright Tree tribe|tribe]] prepared to cook a [[Heroes of Yavin|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] they had captured.

==Biography==
===Motherly Ewok===
Zephee was a [[Gender|female]] [[Ewok]]<ref name="FC" /> who, in [[32 BBY]], was [[Reproduction|born]] on [[Endor]],<ref name="Cosbaby" /> a [[forest]] [[moon]] where she lived as part of the [[Bright Tree tribe]] in [[Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> She had two daughters,<ref name="FC" /> giving [[Reproduction|birth]] to [[Nippet]] in [[3 BBY]]<ref name="Nippet">{{Instagram|username=cosbaby|url=p/DITPyRovgoz/?img_index=1|name=[[Hot Toys|Cosbaby By Hot Toys]]|date=2025-04-11|quote=Baby Nippet embodies a sense of wonder and innocence that captivates everyone around her as the youngest Ewok and the legacy of her kind. With wide-eyed curiosity, she explores the lush forests of Endor, discovering the beauty of her environment and the joy of friendship. Her playful nature brings joy and lightness to the group, reminding them of the true essence of love and happiness. #HotToysCollectibles #Cosbaby #Cosbi #StarWars #Lucasfilm #Ewok #BabyNippet|archiveurl=https://archive.is/RxKaW|archivefile=File:Cosbaby-Nippet-Instagram.png}}</ref> and a second daughter while the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[superweapon]] was being constructed<ref name="FC" /> by the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Endor system]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

The [[battle station]] was visible in the skies of Endor, and its construction progressed as Zephee's infant daughter grew, leaving the mother to wonder what terrible omens the completion of the [[Death Star]] would bring for her [[Bright Tree tribe|tribe]] and children.<ref name="FC" /> She helped Nippet learn and explore their forest home with her gentle touch and warm smile, teaching her the true essence of being an Ewok.<ref name="Cosbaby" />

===Battle of Endor===
[[File:Zephee-FC.png|thumb|250px|rightleft|Zephee's second daughter was born during the construction of the second Death Star.]]
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Zephee was stood on the balcony of a hut on the edge of the village center when<ref name="ROTJ" /> a [[scout]]ing party led by the Ewok [[Teebo]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> returned with a [[Heroes of Yavin|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] that had been caught in one of the tribe's net traps. Zephee scratched her [[ear]] as she watched the scouting party begin to prepare the prisoners to be cooked as part of a great banquet, which was to be held in honor of their comrade [[C-3PO]], who the Ewoks had mistaken for the deity<ref name="ROTJ" /> known as the [[Golden One]].<ref name="Vader">[[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle 4|''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle'' 4]]</ref>

The captive [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] then used [[the Force]] to lift C-3PO into the air above the village, scaring the Ewoks into freeing the prisoners in order to avoid the god's wrath. The Ewoks then aided the rebels in the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the Death Star was destroyed.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Zephee was a nuturing and compassionate individual who acted as a motherly figure among her tribe, caring deeply for everyone around her. She made each individual feel valued and understood due to her unique talent for listening, fostering a strong sense of community and encouraging care for others through her gentle guidance. Zephee had [[Color|grayish brown]] and white [[Hair|fur]], light skin, and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Cosbaby" />

==Equipment==
Zephee wore a brown [[Clothing|hood]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok that would become known as Zephee first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The Ewok village scenes were filmed between [[January 18]] and [[February 2]], [[1982]] on Stage 3 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

The character of Zephee originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where she was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Lumat/Legends|Lumat]] and [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], and [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]].<ref name="YubNub">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref> This character first appeared as "Mama Ewok" in the [[1984]] children's book ''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''<ref name="Picnic">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref> and then received a name in the book ''[[The Haunted Village (book)|The Haunted Village]]'',<ref name="HVBooK">[[The Haunted Village (book)|''The Haunted Village'' picture book]]</ref> which was released on [[September 24]], [[1987]] as an adaptation<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Haunted-Village/dp/0583311644|text=Haunted Village}}</ref> of an episode of the ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' television series with the [[The Haunted Village|same name]]<ref name="HVTV">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref> which aired on [[September 14]], [[1985]].<ref name="This Week Mandalorian Trailer">{{ThisWeek|aiAduF3PI8E|The Mandalorian Trailer, Tales from the Galaxy's Edge Updates, and More!|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-trailer-tales-from-the-galaxy-s-edge-updates-and-more}}</ref>

The character was then [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] identified as the Ewok who appeared in ''Return of the Jedi'' by the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="FC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref>
